speaker: Tomas
text: The bridge is out. We cross at the mill instead.

speaker: Mara
text: Cover me while I get this door open, and watch the roof!

speaker: Radio
text: All units, the convoy leaves at dawn. Anyone not on it stays behind.

speaker: Mara
text: Dawn. Fine. Then we sleep in the mill tonight.

speaker: Mara
text: It held last winter, and the winter before that, and nobody on this crew fixed it then either.

speaker: Radio
text: Repeat: the convoy leaves at dawn.
